scope: One handyman visit to fix lifted roof flashing at a conduit in a difficult-to-access area and clear high spots of soil against the house to correct the grading. Include labor and materials in each task.

A single glass contractor visit to replace an outside 21 by 21 inch insulated window glass unit using an extension ladder, replace two sets of shower-door vinyl seals (back fin, sweep and H strike), and renew silicone at one guest shower. Glass is annealed low-E over clear, 5/8 inch overall, with white bars.
priced_line_descriptions: Replace two sets of shower-door vinyl seals
Apply new silicone to one guest shower

scope: One residential system checkup and addition of a 5-2-1 hard-start kit on a 3–4 ton air-conditioning condenser. Recheck compressor starting current. Customer uses one-time service, with no maintenance membership.

Service two HVAC systems on a townhome under a discounted tune-up offer. Inspect furnace controls and evaporator coils, flush both drains, check refrigerant, wash both rooftop condensers, replace a below-spec Turbo 200 capacitor on each condenser and recheck amperage.
priced_line_descriptions: Supply and fit two Turbo 200 capacitors
Discounted one-time tune-ups for two systems

scope: Historic house with three brick chimneys. Repoint deteriorated masonry above roof, replace broken bricks, renew counterflashing, form concrete crowns, seal and line with refractory coating. Rebuild living-room hearth floor, repair firebrick, smoke chamber and damper, and clean flue. In den, remove false insert, renew floor, firebrick and smoke chamber and clean. Clean bedroom gas fireplace and flue.
priced_line_descriptions: Exterior work on three brick chimneys
Bedroom gas fireplace and flue cleaning

scope: Repair cracks in an upstairs primary bedroom of a historic house, skim-coat the walls and ceiling with joint compound, and sand the surfaces smooth. Supply joint compound and caulk. The room dimensions and crack count were not recorded.
priced_line_descriptions: Labor to skim-coat and sand walls and ceiling

scope: Restore interior wood door faces in a historic residence. Replace all eight listed handles. Five faces need replacement panels: three with small holes to fill, one with a cracked top rail to reinforce, and one with two cracked stiles. For the other three faces, fill holes on the office side of the bathroom, patch added lock holes and veneer on the right library closet, and restore missing wood and holes on the left closet. Use two 4 by 8 foot sheets of quarter-inch birch.
priced_line_descriptions: Bathroom foyer face: handle, panels and hole repairs
Bathroom office face: handle and hole repairs
Right library closet: handle, lock holes and veneer
Left library closet: handle, wood and hole repairs
Study hall right: handle, panels and cracked top rail
Study door: handle, panels and two cracked stiles
Unmarked door: handle, panels and holes
Study hall left: handle, panels and holes

scope: Supply and install a 24-inch Bosch Ascenta SHE3AR75UC built-in stainless dishwasher in place of an existing unit, supply the 6-foot installation kit and remove the old unit. Standard retailer installation with local tax.

Replace 27 metal floor registers around a home with custom-fit unfinished red-oak vents, including several larger air returns. Fit them flush in existing wood flooring, enlarging openings as needed, and match the finish to refinished red oak. Price only the vent portion of the flooring project. The homeowner buys the wood vents, then pays the flooring professional to install them.

Convert two existing ceiling fan boxes into recessed lights in a living room, move an existing pendant fixture box about one foot to center, and correct improper attic wiring connections with new junction boxes. Price contractor-supplied materials and electrician labor. The homeowners handle the pendant installation and ceiling patching.
priced_line_descriptions: Two can lights, trim, wiring and junction boxes

scope: Overhaul hardware on a single residential sectional garage door with a matched pair of high-cycle lifetime-warranty .234 by 2 by 39 inch torsion springs, seven-foot cables, two drums, two end bearing plates, two each of number 1, 2 and 3 hinges, and ten 2-inch diameter ball-bearing rollers with seven-inch stems. Calibrate safety sensors, synchronize remotes/keypads and adjust door. Include shop supplies and applicable net sales tax.
priced_line_descriptions: Net sales tax after invoice tax adjustment

scope: Repaint the exterior of a two-level historic house from white to two shades of gray-green. Include the separately purchased two gallons of porch-floor paint and the contractor’s exterior-painting job. Existing dimensions, preparation and coverage were not itemized.
priced_line_descriptions: Two gallons of homeowner-purchased porch-floor paint
